entry.summary: There are ongoing issues from the geothermal steam bore that provides hot water to heat the Maurie Kjar Aquatic Centre. This is disappointing as the current steam bore was drilled in November 2021, with the funding support of Trust Horizon, which was greatly appreciated by Council and the community.At a depth of 79 metres, the bore accesses naturally hot geothermal water at approximately 145 °C that flows under pressure (called artesian).
